privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Basic information about how URL to Video handles the data needed to generate videos from public URLs.
privacy.intro: URL to Video is a web tool that lets you submit a public URL to generate an MP4 video. This policy explains, in simple terms, what information we use to provide the service.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process the URL you enter, the selected media mode and technical data needed to process the request, such as job identifiers, render status and technical errors if they occur.

purpose.title: How we use the data
purpose.body: We use this information to analyze the submitted URL, generate the script, find visual resources, create the voice, render the MP4 and make it available for download.

sensitive.title: Sensitive data
sensitive.body: We do not ask for passwords, banking information or software installation. You should not submit private URLs, login-protected pages or links containing confidential information.

providers.title: Technical providers
providers.body: The service may rely on external tools for automation, voice generation, visual asset search, rendering and hosting. These tools are used only to provide the requested functionality.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions or data deletion requests, email testappbelleza@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Basic conditions for using URL to Video responsibly.
terms.intro: By using URL to Video, you accept these basic terms. The tool is designed to convert public URLs into vertical videos for social media.

use.title: Allowed use
use.body: You may use the tool to generate videos from news, blogs, articles or public pages related to your activity.

responsibility.title: User responsibility
responsibility.body: You are responsible for the URLs you submit and for the final use of generated videos. You must respect copyright, privacy, trademarks and the rules of the platforms where you publish the content.

limitations.title: Service limitations
limitations.body: The service may fail, take longer than expected or be unable to process some URLs. We do not guarantee continuous availability or perfect results in every case.

prohibited.title: Prohibited uses
prohibited.body: Do not use the tool to create misleading, fraudulent, illegal, abusive, defamatory content or content that impersonates others.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or suggestions, email testappbelleza@gmail.com.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about converting audio to subtitles

srt.question: What is an SRT file and what is it used for?
srt.answer: An SRT is a text file with subtitles and timecodes. It is used to add subtitles to videos in editors, players and platforms.

mp3.question: How can I convert an MP3 to SRT?
mp3.answer: Upload the MP3 file, choose how many words you want per segment and select SRT as the download format.

precision.question: How accurate is the transcription?
precision.answer: Accuracy depends on voice clarity, background noise, language and file quality. Clear spoken audio usually gives better results.

compatibility.question: Does the generated SRT work with CapCut, Premiere or YouTube?
compatibility.answer: Yes. SRT and VTT are common formats for video editors and platforms. CSV is useful if you need to review or reuse segments as data.

formats.question: Which formats can I upload?
formats.answer: The tool supports common audio and video files such as MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, MP4, MOV, WEBM and MKV.

segments.question: Can I choose how many words each subtitle has?
segments.answer: Yes. You can choose between 1 and 20 words per segment before starting the transcription.

privacy.question: Is my file published anywhere?
privacy.answer: No. The file is processed to generate the subtitles and return a download link.
